opening: I have an ulcer on my tongue.
Because of it I've become dehydrated.
Before the ulcer formed, my tongue turned blue.
Before coming here I was first treated with trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole.
After that I was given acyclovir.

opening.text: My tongue hurts and I have an ulcer on it. It also hurts to swallow, and these problems started two weeks ago. Because of it, I've become dehydrated. Before the ulcer formed, my tongue turned blue. Before coming here, I was first treated with trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, then I was given amoxicillin-clavulanate, and after that I was given acyclovir.
